title: Validate document reads through the opened file handle
summary: The bounded workspace document reader used by the Door read operation now checks file type, link count and size through the opened read-only handle. It verifies that the named file and containing directories still identify the same objects before returning bytes, and refuses replacement, new hard links or modification during reading. Allocation and reads remain bounded; public refusal paths remain workspace-relative. File and directory identities retain their full 64-bit precision, so distinct Windows file IDs cannot compare equal through JavaScript number rounding.
